Jordan —

Appreciate the questions. A few technical points to help the team and a proposed test matrix below.

Key differentiators (short):
- Isolation: Redwood Dedicated is a reserved GPU pool for your org with no external tenants in the compute plane — you get predictable per-GPU allocation and we guarantee throughput targets in the SLA for pinned models. Hyperscaler reserved VMs provide capacity reservation but still sit on multi-tenant networking and possible noisy-neighbor interference at the hypervisor/network layer.
- Graceful degradation & fallbacks: our smart routing can automatically route overflow requests to a lower-cost compatible variant (quantized or smaller model) with measurable degradation controls. Hyperscalers generally leave that to your infra to implement unless you build orchestration.
- Runtime-level caching & KV prefix reuse: Redwood has built-in KV cache and prefix reuse which materially reduces token costs for conversational workloads — this is harder to replicate out-of-the-box on a raw VM pool.

Proposed ops test matrix (we can run these during the 7-day dedicated trial + mirror tests on your CloudCorp reserved env):
A) Baseline throughput: steady-state 2M tokens/day for 24h — measure p50/p95/p99 latency and token cost.
B) Peak surge: ramp from 2k -> 8k concurrent sessions over 30 minutes — measure cold-start latency, queueing behavior, and error rate.
C) Tail-latency under cache-less vs 50% cache-hit conditions (we’ll provide harness to toggle).
D) Failover test: simulate region outage and confirm routing to fallback region / model variant; measure failover time and SLA impact.
E) Cost repro: provide identical prompt mix and measure tokens processed / effective cost across both deployments.

Deliverables we’ll provide before trial starts: ops-test checklist (attached), bench harness repo + runbook, and a short commercial note tying reserved capacity tiers to expected throughput (we’ll send the brief).

On the procurement/SLA side: we offer an enterprise SLA for Dedicated (uptime + latency SLOs) and a runbook for incident communication (primary + on-call). For trials, we provide standard onboarding support and a named SE during the window. For longer commitments we can negotiate a tighter escalation path.

If that matrix looks good I’ll slot time with Camila to walk Acme infra through the harness and get dates confirmed.

- Rishi
